blurb: Spirit Reins Ranch offers Western riding lessons for beginners through advanced riders, trail rides through a mountainous coastal region, and summer horse camps for children. Lessons include grooming, horse care, and riding skills. Trail rides require helmets and proper attire and are customized by experience level.
extraNote: 12 hours cancellation notice for private lessons, 24 hours for group bookings · 48 hours notice for cancellations on pre-booked trail rides; 75% charge for no-shows · Lessons may be cancelled by operator due to unforeseen circumstances · Trail rides may be cancelled due to inclement weather at no cost to guest · If weather unsuitable for riding, unmounted lesson given · Spirit Reins Ranch, 432 Prospect Road, Parrsboro, NS · Spring until late fall for trail rides; lessons Monday to Saturday 10 AM to 6 PM
